Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Tikehau Capital SCA is looking for a new strategic investor to help fuel its next phase of growth, according to people familiar with the matter.

The French alternative investment manager has held talks with multiple international firms and investors about selling a stake in itself, the people said, asking not to be identified as the negotiations are private. It has mandated an investment bank to advise on the process, which has been going on for several months, they added.
